purpose: Validate a minimal versioned symbolic namespace capable of losslessly representing the source-qualified q-EPRL Proposition 3.4 braid transformation. This is a schema/representation gate only, not a numerical amplitude gate.
frozen_required_fields: braid_operator with ordered inputs alpha2, alpha1 and source convention metadata
kernel Lambda with dependencies upper=[K2,J], lower=[K1,K], argument=alpha2
roundtrip_acceptance: Two independent implementations serialize -> parse -> canonicalize the canonical Proposition-3.4 exemplar and recover identical free/summed indices, kernel dependencies, ordered input/output representation maps, and domain flag.
null_controls: remove alpha1(K) output dependence -> must fail
flip domain flag to necessarily_EPRL=true -> must fail source-faithful validation
replace braid operator with pair_sign only -> must fail
downstream_if_pass: Authorize a separately preregistered source-to-RC006 symbolic mapping/roundtrip gate. Do not authorize Eq29 numerical amplitude yet.
independence_lock: No historical holdout outcome, S_CROSS choice, target amplitude, or desired Eq29 result enters schema design or validation.
